RewardAllocation.description: One year of a timeshare's points.

RewardMilestone.title: RewardMilestone

RewardProgram.description:
A points, miles, cash back or timeshare program. The balance is the chat's
newest: from a statement (as_of = period end) or given by the owner (manual).
RewardProgram.title: RewardProgram

RewardRoute.description: Which card to use for which spending.
RewardRoute.title: RewardRoute

Rewards.description:
The chat's current view of rewards (state, monthly runs only). Every list
